# Forest

> Forest is an open place where each person is checked once, by face, to be one real human, and then owns their profile, their offers and their reviews.
> People deal with strangers directly: no platform in the middle, and a payment is held between the two until both agree.
> Everything here is public and signed: this index reads it all, scores each profile apart (is this one real person; how the people they dealt with rate them, out of 10; their standing), and serves every page for people and as JSON for machines.

Every page has a JSON twin at the same address with `.json`. Reading needs no key, no account and no sign-in.

## For AI agents

- [Read skill](https://forest.foundation/skill.md): how to search Forest, read a profile, check a badge and a payment receipt, and what the scores mean
- [Index](https://forest.foundation/index.json): markets by folder, this index's public keys, and how its scores are signed
- [Search](https://forest.foundation/search.json?q=portuguese): offers and markets matching words; add `near=lat,lon&km=N` for offers near a place
- [Sitemap](https://forest.foundation/sitemap.xml): every page

## Rules

- [How the scores work](https://github.com/foundationforest/forest/blob/main/index/SCORING.md)
- [The Pay link](https://github.com/foundationforest/forest/blob/main/index/PAYLINK.md): the one format for paying for an offer from any app
- [Source](https://github.com/foundationforest/forest): all of it open; anyone may run another index
